title: The Mooberry Book Manager WordPress plugin through 4.16.2 does not perform a capability check on one of its AJAX…
description: The Mooberry Book Manager WordPress plugin versions up to 4.16.2 contains a vulnerability where an AJAX action lacks a proper capability check and relies solely on a nonce that is exposed to all authenticated users. This flaw allows any logged-in user, including those with minimal privileges such as Subscribers, to trigger a site-wide rewrite of stored book purchase links and modify a related plugin option.
